widget.name: Google Calendar by YourCompany
widget.short_description: Schedule Google Meet meetings from Kommo
widget.description: Connect Google Calendar with Kommo to create and manage Google Meet meetings directly from lead and contact cards. Automatically saves meeting links and dates to custom fields. Requires a Google account.
widget.installation_description:
Thank you for installing Google Calendar Widget!

To get started:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations → Google Calendar Widget → Settings.
2. Authorize your Google account.
3. Select the pipeline and stage where meetings will be moved after scheduling.
4. Map the custom fields for the meeting link and date.

Need help? Contact us at support@yourcompany.com or visit https://yourcompany.com/support
widget.tour_description: Schedule Google Meet meetings directly from Kommo leads and contacts. Connect your Google Calendar, map your custom fields and start booking in seconds.
